notes: Taḥwīl: the first branch (عبيد الله → أبي) and the second (ابن بشار → ابن جعفر) meet at شعبة, written once after the second branch and belonging to both (rule 3).
«ثم ذكر معنى حديث مسدد» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route. The gloss «- قال -» is left out. The uncle «عمه» is the last link.
